walkthrough:
Equate the derivative to the gradient of the parallel line, $m = -3$:
$$3x^2 - 18x + 24 = -3 \implies 3x^2 - 18x + 27 = 0$$
$$x^2 - 6x + 9 = 0 \implies (x - 3)^2 = 0 \implies x = 3$$

Find the $y$-coordinate of the contact point $A$:
$$y = 3^3 - 9(3^2) + 24(3) - 12 = 27 - 81 + 72 - 12 = 6 \implies A = (3, \, 6)$$

Form the equation of the tangent line at $A(3, 6)$:
$$y - 6 = -3(x - 3) \implies y = -3x + 9 + 6 \implies y = -3x + 15$$

Find the intervals where $f'(x) \ge 0$:
$$3x^2 - 18x + 24 \ge 0 \implies 3(x - 2)(x - 4) \ge 0 \implies x \le 2 \quad \text{or} \quad x \ge 4$$

Identify the smallest value of $k$ such that the domain $x \ge k$ is entirely contained within an increasing region:
$$k = 4$$
